messages:
kevin_release: Heads-up — rolling deploy for feature flag `ff/creep_ramp` in the 22:00–23:30 UTC change window. Plan = micro-ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% with 10m soak per step. Pin svc version to `svc@2026.03.21.1`. I'll post release notes shortly.

maria_eng: SG. I'll watch latency + KV cache hit rates. Please pin routing for the canary cohort to avoid cold-cache noise.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: release/2026-03-21 svc@2026.03.21.1 — window starts in 18m. Notify @sre-oncall for monitoring.

sre-oncall: On it. Adding temporary alert: p95>=350ms OR error-rate delta >0.5% -> pager. Also enabling a tight trace-sampling for this rollout.

jamal_pm: Can you drop the release notes link when ready? I'll pre-populate the customer-facing blurb.

olivia_prod: Release notes draft: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-21/creep-ramp (private). I'll keep it updated.

kevin_release: Executing ramp steps via ops tool. Commands I'll run (copy/paste):
```bash
# step 1: micro open to 1%
/ff set creep_ramp percent=1 --by=kevin_release --msg="micro-ramp step 1"
# after soak -> bump to 5%
/ff set creep_ramp percent=5 --by=kevin_release --msg="micro-ramp step 2"
# final -> 20%
/ff set creep_ramp percent=20 --by=kevin_release --msg="micro-ramp step 3"
```

maria_eng: Quick note — please pin model routing to `model-v2` for the canary cohort to avoid mixing v1 cache shards. Command I used: `/route pin cohort=canary model=model-v2`

deploy-bot: Deploy started: svc@2026.03.21.1 (preflight checks passed).

kevin_release: Step 1 -> set to 1% (rolling). Monitoring for 10m.

deploy-bot: Flag update: creep_ramp = 1% (actor: kevin_release).

maria_eng: Observability OK at 1% — p95 stable ~150ms, error% unchanged. Proceeding to bump in 3m unless anyone objects.

kevin_release: Bumping to 5% now.

deploy-bot: Flag update: creep_ramp = 5% (actor: kevin_release).

sre-oncall: Alert firing: p95 increased from ~160ms -> ~420ms across route group `svc-edge` at ~2m after the 5% bump. Investigating.

maria_eng: I see the same. KV miss rate jumped on canary nodes, CPU on canary GPU hosts spiked. Hypothesis: new code path increased cache churn under the cohort.

kevin_release: Hold the ramp. Rolling the flag back to 1% and draining canary. If metrics don't recover in 5m we'll 1) keep at 1% and 2) trigger a rollback to previous service version.

deploy-bot: Flag update: creep_ramp = 1% (actor: kevin_release) — hold.

sre-oncall: After drain, p95 trending back to ~170ms. Error rate normalizing. Recommend holding at 1% and triage first thing tomorrow.

jamal_pm: Noting for release notes: "Partial rollback/hold at 1% due to transient p95 spike after 5% bump; canary drained. Investigation in progress."

olivia_prod: Updated public changelog with the interim note: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-21/creep-ramp — flagged as "investigating".

maria_eng: Action items: capture heap/kv metrics from canary nodes, diff recent kernel module versions (we saw a minor infra change this morning), and reproduce in a synthetic canary test.

kevin_release: Agreed. For the deploy record: pin remains `svc@2026.03.21.1` (no rollback yet), feature flag at 1% hold. Will re-run micro-ramp only after root cause identified and mitigations in place.

sre-oncall: I'll keep the alert thresholds tightened for next 12h and will escalate if any regression.

kevin_release: Thanks all — closing this thread for active rollout. If we get a go for a second attempt, I'll post a new thread with the post-fix ramp plan. :white_check_mark:
